text:
Maya Patel: FYI i found a confusing example in optimize/batching.mdthe prefetch snippet still shows global kv_prefetch and the Python uses the old flat config. i'm opening a small docs PR to swap to route-scoped caching, add concise short-seq guidance, and include tiny py + go snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/13002
Alex Chen: perfect. please call out the behavior change for short sequences (<64 tokens) and recommend short_seq_mode with an example max_batch_tokens value. engineers keep tripping on defaults.
Maya Patel: added a short paragraph and this Python example in the PR body:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
# route-local batching + caching example for chat-route (short sequences)
client.optimize.update_route_config("chat-route", {
    "batching": {"max_batch_tokens": 800, "short_seq_mode": True},
    "caching": {"kv_prefetch": {"enabled": True, "prefix_cache_size": 256}}
})
```
Jordan Rivera: tiny SDK note: in v0.8+ the method is `update_route_config` so the example looks good. prefer nesting kv_prefetch under `caching` (you did). add one-line migration guidance about avoiding global prefetch to prevent cross-route evictions.
Maya Patel: added the migration bullet: "If you enabled global kv_prefetch, migrate to route-scoped caching to prevent cross-route evictions and unpredictable cache churn."
Samir Gupta: can you add a Go snippet for folks on dedicated/private environments? show ShortSeqMode + PrefixCacheSize fields and a streaming hint.
Maya Patel: included a compact Go snippet:
```go
import "github.com/redwood/inference/sdk"
client := sdk.NewClient()
cfg := sdk.RouteConfig{
    Batching: sdk.Batching{MaxBatchTokens: 800, ShortSeqMode: true},
    Caching: sdk.Caching{KVPrefetch: sdk.KVPrefetch{Enabled: true, PrefixCacheSize: 256}},
}
client.UpdateRouteConfig("chat-route", cfg)
```
DocsBot: docs-pr-checker: running link + anchor checks for PR #13002
Alex Chen: add a short note about fallback quant profiles when you route to cheaper fallback models recommend `qprofile: balanced-16bit` over `small-8bit` to reduce regression risk. one sentence is enough.
Maya Patel: added the fallback quant note and linked to optimize/quant-profiles.md. i also noticed batching.md referenced `#kv-prefetch` anchor which 404s i'm adding a redirect and renaming anchors to `#kv-prefetch-route` to be explicit.
Jordan Rivera: reviewed the snippets, left two micro-nits (Go import path style and a capitalization in the struct field comment). suggested adding a one-line empirical note: short_seq_mode reduced p95 latency by ~30% in our internal tests for <64 token sequences.
Maya Patel: added that latency note and addressed nits. CI passed, docs lint okay. merged with changelog: `docs: swap global prefetch example for route-scoped caching; add short-seq guidance and py/go snippets; include fallback quant note; fix kv-prefetch anchor redirect`
Samir Gupta: thanks! small win for migrations. :tada:
